mechanisms_2022: Expanded expense base in anticipation of growth, plus ADESA consolidation.
Faster vehicle depreciation and higher reconditioning/inbound transport expense hurt vehicle margins.
Rapidly rising benchmark rates and fewer loan sales hurt other gross profit.
Full-year retail decline3% conceals Q4 decline23%.
Interest expense is excluded from adjusted EBITDA; debt exacerbated liquidity pressure but does not explain this operating earnings decline directly.
actions_2023: Lower headcount, advertising and office footprint.
Reduced inventory and faster turns; lower reconditioning and inbound costs.
Debt exchange relieved near-term cash demands, separate from operating recovery.
